description: This file defines classes, data structures, and function declarations related to trigger decoding in engine control firmware. It includes trigger state management, synchronization handling, and statistical tracking for trigger events.

classes.name: TriggerState
classes.description: Manages the current trigger state, including decoding, validation, and error handling.

classes.name: TriggerStateWithRunningStatistics
classes.description: Extends TriggerState with additional statistics and RPM calculation for real-time monitoring.

methods.name: getCurrentIndex
methods.description: Returns the current trigger processing index.

methods.name: getTotalRevolutionCounter
methods.description: Returns the total number of revolutions counted.

methods.name: isEvenRevolution
methods.description: Indicates whether the current revolution is even.

methods.name: handleTriggerError
methods.description: Handles trigger errors detected during decoding.

methods.name: onSynchronizationLost
methods.description: Handles loss of synchronization in trigger decoding.

methods.name: isValidIndex
methods.description: Checks if the current index is valid.

methods.name: getTriggerDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates the duty cycle for a trigger channel.

methods.name: resetTriggerState
methods.description: Resets the trigger state to initial conditions.

methods.name: calculateInstantRpm
methods.description: Calculates the instantaneous RPM based on trigger events.
